rationale: Louan's deep expertise in applied ML for clinical neuroimaging—including segmentation pipelines and lesion detection—could directly inform product decisions at Tendo, a medical-robotics company where Erta drives user-centered product design. Both are based in San Francisco and work at the intersection of advanced technology and healthcare, making this a natural conversation about how cutting-edge ML translates to medical product problems.
intro_message: Louan, meet Erta Muca — she's a PM at Tendo (medical robotics) and came up as a great fit given your work on clinical ML pipelines and her focus on healthcare product design.
